scripts.text:
[Amachang]
Welcome to ^8B4513Amatsu^000000,
the town of kind towners
and beautiful cherry blossoms.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛畅]
欢迎来到^8B4513樱花城^000000，这里樱花烂漫，居民热情友善。

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
I'm Amachang,
the 13th Miss Amatsu.
I will guide you about town
as Miss Amatsu.
Please tell me
if you want to know something.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛畅]
我是第13届樱花城小姐阿玛畅。
作为樱花城小姐，我会为您介绍这座城镇。
有什么想了解的，尽管问吧。

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!
scripts.translation:
[阿玛畅]
点击^B9062F[地点名称]^000000，便可获得最先进的^B9062F导航^000000服务！
